title: Maximum Product of Three Numbers
description: Find the maximum product of three numbers in an array by sorting and comparing the product of the three largest numbers vs the product of the two smallest and the largest.
pseudocode:
1. Sort the array nums in ascending order.
2. Calculate product1 = nums[n-1] * nums[n-2] * nums[n-3].
3. Calculate product2 = nums[0] * nums[1] * nums[n-1].
4. Return max(product1, product2).

steps.note: Sort the array [1, 2, 3] in ascending order.

fullDescription:
Given an integer array nums, find three numbers whose product is maximum and return the maximum product.

 

Example 1:

Input: nums = [1,2,3]
Output: 6

Example 2:

Input: nums = [1,2,3,4]
Output: 24

Example 3:

Input: nums = [-1,-2,-3]
Output: -6

 

Constraints:

  • 3 <= nums.length <= 104
  • -1000 <= nums[i] <= 1000
